aboutPage.lead: A concise bilingual guide to six chosen places in East Nusa Tenggara: nature, culture, and how to get there.
aboutPage.vision: To be a concise, trustworthy digital guide to chosen places in East Nusa Tenggara, for travellers from Indonesia and the world.
aboutPage.mission: To offer travel information that is sourced, visual, easy to find, bilingual, and mindful of local context.
four: We chose just six places so each one can be done carefully rather than merely listed.
Every photo has a clear credit and permission.
Descriptions, access and cost estimates record their sources and the date they were checked. What has no data is stated as such.
Spotted something wrong or out of date? Send a report from any place’s page and our team will check it.
aboutPage.care: Every piece of content records its source and check date. Every photo needs a clear licence or permission. Costs are estimates and can change, so confirm with the manager before you go.
aboutPage.noBooking: Pilihan Timur does not sell tickets, hotels, or trips. It helps you get to know a place and prepare for the journey.

six.body: Six places in East Nusa Tenggara we recommend, with photos, routes and estimated costs.
six.aboutBody: Pilihan Timur ("The Six NTT Picks") is a short bilingual (ID/EN) guide to six hand-picked places in East Nusa Tenggara. Information is recorded together with its sources and the date it was checked.
six.mapLabel: Schematic of the six picks across Flores, west to east
six.mapNote: A schematic of relative positions from west to east, not a scale map.

trip.budgetNone: Cost information for this place is not available yet. Ask the local site manager.
trip.budgetNote: Only components with a source (tickets and transport). Food, lodging and souvenirs are not included.
trip.mapNote: The link opens a search for the place name, not official coordinates. Check the current route before you go.

plan.body: Pick your home city anywhere in Indonesia. We show the suggested gateway airport in Flores and direct links to sites that list ticket prices, then you can work out the total cost from your city.
plan.pickHint: Choose a home city to see ticket-check links.
plan.mapLabel: Map of Indonesia: home cities and Flores, NTT
plan.mapNote: Schematic map. The dashed line only shows direction, not a flight route.
plan.otherNote: From Java, Sumatra and other islands, sea ships, ferries and trains are also options. Check schedules and fares directly on the provider's site.
plan.flightsNote: Fares change every day, so always check the provider’s site. The gateway airport is the suggested nearest airport for each place.
plan.quake: An M7.7 earthquake on 15 August 2026 briefly closed some destinations in Flores. According to BPOLBF (data as of 23 August 2026) the airports at Labuan Bajo, Ende, Maumere, Ruteng and Bajawa are operating and main roads are passable, but some destinations remain closed and aftershocks continue. Do not force visits to closed places, and check status with the manager before you go.

calc.h: Work out the cost from your city
calc.intro: Enter the ticket price you found on a provider's site. On-site costs (entry and local transport) are pre-filled from our sources. What you type stays on your device.
calc.fillFare: Enter a ticket price (from the links above) to see the total.
calc.formula: Tickets × people + lodging × nights + food × days × people + sourced on-site costs.
calc.noFare: No ticket price entered yet, so the total is incomplete.
calc.disclaimer: Estimated prices. Souvenirs, foreign-visitor tickets, boat hire and unexpected costs are not included; see the cost notes above.

fares.none: No example price for this route yet; check with the links above.
fares.disc: Quoted from ticket aggregators on the date shown. Fares change daily and may differ when you book.
